pages.title: About Us: Institutional Overview
pages.subtitle: UGC Section 5(a) · Vision, Mission & Heritage since 1998
pages.contentHtml:
Institutional Profile

Shri Vithal College of Engineering & Research (SVCOER), Pandharpur is an Autonomous Engineering Institute established in 1998 under the Shri Vithal Education & Research Trust. Inspired by academic rigor and rural-to-global technological empowerment, the institute offers AICTE-approved Undergraduate (B.Tech), Postgraduate (M.Tech, MBA, MCA), and Doctoral (Ph.D.) programs.

ParticularsInstitutional Record
Name of InstitutionShri Vithal College of Engineering & Research (Autonomous)
Year of Establishment1998 (Autonomous Status Conferred by UGC in 2021)
Affiliating UniversityPunyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Solapur University, Solapur
AISHE CodeC-15892
NAAC AccreditationGrade 'A+' (CGPA 3.42 / 4.00, Cycle 2)
Campus Area25.4 Acres (Barrier-free green campus)

Vision & Mission

Vision: To be recognized among the premier engineering institutions fostering ethically grounded, industry-ready technologists and researchers.

Mission: Impart outcome-based technical education, nurture interdisciplinary research and entrepreneurship, and uphold complete institutional transparency in alignment with NEP 2020.

pages.title: Admission Process & Eligibility Guidelines
pages.subtitle: UGC Section 5(d) · CAP Centralized Admissions & Institute Level Quota
pages.contentHtml:
Admission Procedure

Admissions to First Year B.Tech and Direct Second Year (Lateral Entry) are conducted transparently through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) of the State CET Cell, Government of Maharashtra, based on MHT-CET / JEE (Main) merit.

  • Step 1: Register on Maharashtra State CET Cell CAP Portal (DTE Code: EN-6220).
  • Step 2: Document Verification at Scrutiny Centre & Option Form submission.
  • Step 3: Seat Allotment confirmation & reporting at SVCOER Admission Cell with original certificates.
